name: CreateArtifactSubscriptionRule

parameters.help_en:
The source of the artifact.

Valid values:

DOCKER_HUB: Docker Hub
GCR: GCR
QUAY: Quay.io
parameters.name: source_provider

parameters.help_zh: 源端命名空间，当 `SourceProvider` 为 `DOCKER_HUB` 时有默认值 `library`，其他场景必填
parameters.name: source_namespace_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the Container Registry namespace
parameters.name: namespace_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the Container Registry repository
parameters.name: repo_name

parameters.help_en: The image tag in the subscription source repository. Regular expressions are supported
parameters.help_zh: 订阅源端仓库镜像版本, 支持正则表达式
parameters.name: tag_regexp

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the original image is overwritten
parameters.name: override

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether an acceleration link is enabled for image subscription. The subscription acceleration feature is in public preview. The feature is optimized based on scheduling policies and network links to accelerate image subscription
parameters.help_zh:
开启加速链路，订阅加速功能公测中，基于调度策略与网络链路优化，
可提升镜像订阅速度
parameters.name: accelerate

parameters.help_en: The operating system and architecture. If the source repository contains a multi-arch image, only the specified operating system and architecture are subscribed to the destination repository of the Enterprise Edition instance. Subscribe to the destination repository of an Enterprise Edition instance
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统/架构，当源端仓库中为多架构镜像时，只将指定的操作系统/架构
订阅到企业版实例的目标仓库
parameters.name: platform

IsSuccess.description_en:
Indicate whether the API request is successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request is successful.
`false`: The request fails
IsSuccess.description_zh:
是否调用API成功，取值：

`true`：调用API成功

`false`：调用API失败

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the artifact subscription rule
